arabic text: KARDE KARAM SAQQA E HARAM\nYA MOLA SAKHI ABBAS E ALI
english translation text: Show mercy, O water-bearer of the sanctuary;\nO generous Maula, Abbas son of Ali.

arabic text: GHAM SE JAB GHABRAAYE HAIN, TERE ALAM PE AAYE HAIN\nTANHAAI MAIN AKSAR HI, ROYE HAIN CHILLAAYE HAIN\nDEKHO TO HAIN TAKLEEF MAIN HUM
english translation text: Whenever grief frightens us, we come to your standard.\nIn loneliness we have often wept and cried aloud.\nLook—we are in distress.

arabic text: KHAALI DAMAN BHARTE HO, KHAMOSHI BHI SUNTE HO\nCHHORD DIYA MUJHE APNON NE, TUM HI MERE APNE HO\nDOOR KARO HAR RANJ O ALAM
english translation text: You fill empty hands and hear even silence.\nMy loved ones abandoned me; you alone are mine.\nRemove every grief and sorrow.

arabic text: DARD MERE SUN LO MOLA, HAAL MERA DEKHO MOLA\nMERA AQEEDA HAI KE TUM, BAAB-E-HAWAIJ HO MOLA\nSAR PAR RAKH DEIN DAST-E-KARAM
english translation text: Hear my pain, Maula; look upon my condition.\nMy faith is that you are the Gate of Needs.\nPlace your hand of grace upon my head.

arabic text:
ASHK HAI MERI AANKHON MAIN, DAM HI NAHI HAI SAANSON
MAIN
DIL BHI CHOOR GHAMON SE HAI, DARD HAI MERI BAATO’N MAIN
HAATHON MAIN HAI TERA ALAM
english translation text:
Tears fill my eyes, and there is
little breath within me. My heart is
shattered by sorrow, and pain fills my
words. Your standard is within my hands.

arabic text: ROTA HOON BEHLAO TUM, MO'JIZA YE DIKHLAAO TUM\nEK YEHII KHWAAHISH HAI MERI, DAR PE MUJHE BULAAO TUM\nKARWA DO DEEDAAR-E-HARAM
english translation text: I weep—console me and show me this miracle.\nI have only one desire: call me to your door.\nGrant me the sight of your sanctuary.

arabic text: AHL-E-AZA YE BAAT SUNO, DIL KI BAATEIN UN SE KARO\nAAJ KE BAAD AZLAAN O KARIM BAAT KOI DIL MAIN NA RAKHO\nWO HI MITAAENGAY SAB GHAM
english translation text: O people of mourning, listen: speak your hearts to him.\nAfter today, Azlaan and Karim, keep nothing within your hearts.\nHe alone will remove every sorrow.
